what: Volatile-only skip lacks fail-closed handling when restore/clean or repo-wide porcelain check fails
scenario_or_breakage: Plan requires classify-before-add, git restore/clean, then repo-wide empty porcelain, but does not require checking return codes or raising on leftover dirty paths. An implementer could return CommandResult(("true",),0,...) after a failed restore, leaving M/?? under rel or outside rel; rebase._force_push_branch then hits dirty worktree (Stalled) or, worse, races with a partial index state
suggested_fix: After each git restore/clean/reset, require returncode==0 or raise ShipError; after cleanup call git.status_porcelain(repo-wide); if stdout non-empty raise ShipError with the porcelain snippet (maps to JSON STALLED via #4). Do not treat failed cleanup as a no-op success
